description: Set key value pairs in Redis database.

parameters.name: ca_certs
parameters.description: Path to root certificates file. If not set and tls is set to true, certifi’s CA certificates are used.

parameters.name: client_cert_file
parameters.description: Path to the client certificate file.

parameters.name: client_key_file
parameters.description: Path to the client private key file.

parameters.name: existing
parameters.description: Only set key if it already exists. Choices: false true

parameters.name: expiration
parameters.description: Expiration time in milliseconds. Setting this option always results in a change in the database.

parameters.name: keep_ttl
parameters.description: Retain the time to live associated with the key. Choices: false true

parameters.name: login_host
parameters.description: Specify the target host running the database. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: login_password
parameters.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Usually not used when target is localhost.

parameters.name: login_port
parameters.description: Specify the port to connect to. Default: 6379

parameters.name: login_user
parameters.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Requires redis >= 3.4.0.

parameters.name: non_existing
parameters.description: Only set key if it does not already exist. Choices: false true

parameters.name: tls
parameters.description: Specify whether or not to use TLS for the connection. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Specify whether or not to validate TLS certificates. This should only be turned off for personally controlled sites or with localhost as target. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value that key should be set to.

examples:
- name: Set key foo=bar on localhost with no username
  community.general.redis_data:
    login_host: localhost
    login_password: supersecret
    key: foo
    value: bar
    state: present

- name: Set key foo=bar if non existing with expiration of 30s
  community.general.redis_data:
    login_host: localhost
    login_password: supersecret
    key: foo
    value: bar
    non_existing: true
    expiration: 30000
    state: present

- name: Set key foo=bar if existing and keep current TTL
  community.general.redis_data:
    login_host: localhost
    login_password: supersecret
    key: foo
    value: bar
    existing: true
    keep_ttl: true

- name: Set key foo=bar on redishost with custom ca-cert file
  community.general.redis_data:
    login_host: redishost
    login_password: supersecret
    login_user: someuser
    validate_certs: true
    ssl_ca_certs: /path/to/ca/certs
    key: foo
    value: bar

- name: Delete key foo on localhost with no username
  community.general.redis_data:
    login_host: localhost
    login_password: supersecret
    key: foo
    state: absent

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: A short message. Returned: always Sample: "Set key: foo to bar"

return_values.name: old_value
return_values.description: Value of key before setting. Returned: on_success if state=present and key exists in database. Sample: "old_value_of_key"

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: Value key was set to. Returned: on success if state=present. Sample: "new_value_of_key"
